name: ce.memory_read
description: Read bounded raw or typed target memory and return resolved addresses. Raw encoding honors hex or base64, with base64 conversion in the sidecar. For string/wstring, maxStringBytes is a strict byte budget including the terminator; wide reads use only whole 2-byte units. String complete is true only when a terminator is observed within the budget; reaching the limit without one is incomplete.

encoding.description: Select hex (default) or base64 for raw bytes; the sidecar converts bridge hex bytes to base64 when requested.

maxStringBytes.description: Strict byte budget for string/wstring, including terminator reads, not a character count. Wide reads use whole 2-byte units only, leaving an odd final byte unread. String complete is true only if a terminator is observed within this budget.

complete.description: For string/wstring, true only when a terminator was observed within maxStringBytes; a readable but unterminated prefix is incomplete. For raw and other typed reads, indicates whether all requested bytes or values were read.
